body:
## Pull request overview

This PR consolidates redundant protocol definitions to reduce fragmentation in the ObjectStack specification package. The consolidation merges basic logger schemas into the comprehensive logging protocol and scoped storage schemas into the object storage protocol.

**Changes:**
- Merged logger protocol (`logger.zod.ts` → `logging.zod.ts`) with hierarchical logger support via `default` and `loggers` fields in `LoggingConfigSchema`
- Merged scoped storage protocol (`scoped-storage.zod.ts` → `object-storage.zod.ts`) with expanded `StorageScopeSchema` (added `global`, `tenant`, `user`, `session`) and new fields (`scope`, `location`, `quota`, `options`) in `ObjectStorageConfigSchema`
- Updated all JSON schemas, tests, and system documentation to reflect the consolidated structure

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 20 out of 20 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/system/logging.zod.ts | Consolidated basic logger schemas (LogLevel, LogFormat, LoggerConfig, LogEntry) from logger.zod.ts with hierarchical logger support |
| packages/spec/src/system/logging.test.ts | Added comprehensive tests for basic logger schemas and hierarchical logger configuration |
| packages/spec/src/system/object-storage.zod.ts | Merged scoped storage schemas (StorageScope, FileMetadata) with extended scope options and new configuration fields |
| packages/spec/src/system/object-storage.test.ts | Added tests for storage scope, file metadata, and new configuration fields |
| packages/spec/src/system/index.ts | Removed exports for deleted files with comment noting scoped storage functionality is now in object-storage |
| packages/spec/src/system/logger.zod.ts | Deleted - schemas moved to logging.zod.ts |
| packages/spec/src/system/scoped-storage.zod.ts | Deleted - schemas moved to object-storage.zod.ts |
| content/docs/references/system/*.mdx | Updated documentation to reflect consolidated schemas |
| packages/spec/json-schema/system/*.json | Updated generated JSON schemas with new structure |
</details>

The logger and scoped-storage references have been removed from the system documentation, but there are still outdated documentation files in content/docs/references/kernel/logger/ and content/docs/references/kernel/scoped-storage/ that reference the old schemas. These should either be updated to reference the new consolidated schemas (logging.zod.ts and object-storage.zod.ts) or removed entirely to maintain documentation consistency.

The PR description claims "No breaking changes", but this is technically incorrect. The removal of ScopedStorageConfigSchema and StorageAdapterType exports from scoped-storage.zod.ts represents a breaking change for external consumers who may be importing these directly. While the functionality has been merged into ObjectStorageConfigSchema (via scope, location, quota, and options fields) and StorageProviderSchema respectively, external code using the old exports will break. Consider either: (1) adding backward-compatible export aliases in object-storage.zod.ts, (2) updating the PR description to acknowledge the breaking change, or (3) adding a migration guide documenting how to update from the old to new schemas.
